verdict.rationale: telli has a workflow system. Workflows normally run on call events, and a Scheduled trigger adds time-based runs ([telli-docs-1]). They can trigger actions such as SMS/WhatsApp sends with dynamic recipients and AI-generated content ([telli-docs-5], [telli-docs-6]), and webhooks fire on call events, status changes and outcomes ([telli-docs-13], [telli-docs-21]). Charlie, the built-in assistant, can help automate workflows ([telli-docs-11]). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the available event trigger types and conditional rule logic (if/then filters), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
